question: In a certain code language, LOTION is written as ORWJRQ and DENSE is written as EFQVF. How will CRANK be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

1) In Double-digit letters add 3.

2) In Single-digit letters add 1.

The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

__LOGIC__:

1) In Double-digit letters add 3.

2) In Single-digit letters add 1.

In LOTION →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5142ac7fd94eb390b8dbc4f45239d10c3751c9adcaee772255c6a28f06e994ba.png] 

And;

In DENSE →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/553ab02637ee609da7616bab03f077d30c6c2005119949e1d3f417ef29797145.png] 

Similarly;

In CRANK →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54f2d637ec4cef5c0a5061b8ea9de5d3812d761f5a3353e791e8bb6aef11d3e4.png] 

Hence, "DUBQN" is the correct answer.
